result.topic_en: The page has two irregular closed curves drawn in pencil, plus a marked line segment labelled as the height of the eye above the plane of the paper, apparently a set-up for viewing or projecting the figures in perspective.
result.transcription:
B. Riemann

215

Höhe des Auges über der Ebene des Papiers

[two irregular closed pencil curves; a long vertical line with cross-marks at both ends, beside which the caption is written]
